fields.name: Bulwark of Faith

fields.name: Seal of Command
fields.description: A 30 s self Seal: a landed white swing has 7 procs a minute (vmangos) of a holy hit of 70% of a weapon roll (20424). Judged: a holy hit under Judgement of Command (20467). Holy ignores armour.

fields.name: Seal of the Crusader
fields.description: A 30 s self Seal that replaces any other: 20 + 4 attack power a level, swings 40% faster with each hit cut to match (so the haste alone adds no damage a second). Judged: Judgement of the Crusader Rank 3 (20300) on the target for 10 s, 20% more holy damage taken (vanilla's is a flat amount), its duration refreshed by each landed white swing at the target.

fields.name: Judgement
fields.description: Consumes the active Seal for that Seal's judgement; with no Seal it fails and costs nothing.

fields.name: Eviscerate
fields.description: Finishing move: Physical damage that grows with each combo point.

fields.name: Rupture
fields.description: Finishing move: a bleed that deals damage every 2 sec for 6 sec, plus 2 sec and more damage per combo point. You heal for 40% of the damage it deals. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby.

fields.name: Garrote
fields.description: From Stealth: garrote the enemy, causing it to bleed every 3 sec for 18 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Each tick may spill a blood droplet nearby.

fields.name: Evasion

fields.name: Stealth
fields.description: Out of combat only. Mobs ignore you unless very close; your first attack from stealth is a critical strike and breaks it.

fields.name: Ley-Spark
fields.description: Your primary casted filler. Deals Arcane damage. Its critical strike chance naturally scales higher based on how full your current mana pool is.

fields.name: Searing Ember
fields.description: Instant cast. Deals low initial Fire damage and leaves a stacking burn DoT on the target.
fields.aura_description: Burning for Fire damage every 3 sec.

fields.name: Biting Cold
fields.description: Deals moderate Frost damage and heavily slows the target's movement speed for 6 seconds.

fields.name: Catalyst
fields.description: The detonator. Consumes your Searing Embers and Biting Colds on the target. If it consumes an Ember, it instantly refunds 10% of your maximum Mana. If it consumes a Cold, it deals a massive burst of shatter damage.

fields.name: Blink
fields.description: Teleports you forward 20 yards and frees you from stuns and roots.

fields.name: Ley Ward
fields.description: Surrounds you with a ward of ley energy that absorbs damage equal to 10% of your maximum mana for 20 sec.

fields.name: Auto Shot
fields.description: Automatically shoots the target with your ranged weapon until cancelled.

fields.name: Snapshot
fields.description: Instant cast. Low mana cost. Your primary mobile filler. Fires a quick physical arrow at the target.

fields.name: Puncturing Shaft
fields.description: Your heavy artillery. Deals massive physical damage and naturally ignores a flat amount of the target's armor.

fields.name: Barbed Arrow
fields.description: Sinks a jagged arrow into the target, dealing physical damage over time and slowing their movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds.
fields.aura_description: Physical damage over time. Movement speed slowed by 30%.

fields.name: Vault

fields.name: Creeping Blight

fields.aura_description: Taking Shadow damage over time. It grows with every tick.

fields.name: Blood Lance
fields.description: Rips a crystallized spike of blood from your own veins and hurls it at the target, dealing heavy Shadow damage and granting a moderate Heal-over-Time to the lowest-health ally within 15 yards of the target. If the target has your Creeping Blight, it gains a stack.

fields.name: Dark Mending
fields.description: Instantly heals the target ally for a massive amount, but applies a minor Shadow DoT to them that ticks away 15% of the healed amount over 6 seconds. Costs 15% of your health. 8 second cooldown.

fields.name: Miasma
fields.description: Drops a localized cloud of dark mist at the target location for 10 seconds. Enemies inside take Shadow damage; allies inside receive 15% increased healing from all sources.

fields.name: Siphon Life
fields.description: Violently drains health from the target, dealing Shadow damage and rapidly restoring your own health pool.

fields.name: Rebuke
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 4 seconds. When it stops a cast, you gain a stack of Conviction.

fields.name: Bulwark Taunt

fields.name: Kick

fields.name: Sap

fields.name: Counterspell

fields.name: Ember Blast

fields.name: Silencing Shot
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 3 seconds. When it stops a cast, your Vault is ready again.

fields.name: Snare Trap
fields.description: Lays a trap at your feet that arms after 2 sec and lasts 60 sec. The first enemy that is not a boss to step on it is incapacitated for 12 sec. Damage breaks it. Only one trap at a time.

fields.name: Hush
fields.description: Stops the spell the target is casting and locks it out of that spell's school for 4 seconds. When it stops a cast, Creeping Blight settles on the target, or gains a stack if it is already there.

fields.name: Grasping Shadows
fields.description: Shrouds the target area in grasping shadows for 10 sec. Enemies inside move 60% slower, and a boss 30% slower.
